COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY LIBRARIES
Special Collections

Spec. Mss Coll.-Mexico

1772
no. 660

Barrientos, Manuel (Vicar General and acting Archbishop)
A. L. S. and Ms. D. S. 8pp. sm. fol. 1772.
Dispensation of the publication of banns before marriage.
The relatives of the woman were opposed to the match, and
the parties wished to be married secretly so that it would
be too late for any active interference.
